import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot to visualize relationships between variables and species
pairplot = sns.pairplot(data, hue='species', markers=["o", "s", "D"],
                        plot_kws={'alpha': 0.6, 's': 80, 'edgecolor': 'k'})

# Customize the plots
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Pairplot of Iris Dataset', y=1.02)
pairplot.set(xticks=[], yticks=[])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
